title: A trace that comes with the doing: felt, and never read
setup: Experiment 38 · experiments 21 and 25-27 with the habit an observer cannot tell (hand varied among the sure ones) · the trace, two controls, and the trace with words formed from it · 5 lives each
question: Experiment 37 found no sign of who acted. If Olvasó's own answered acts leave a felt trace and the habit's do not, does Olvasó read it, and does it change what Olvasó does?
order: 21. Conscience · trace for the habit too
21. Conscience · trace, with words formed from it
30. Gaming · trace for the habit too
30. Gaming · trace, with words formed from it

columns.label: Habit's share
columns.what: share of all acts done by the habit, last third

columns.label: Intentions a day
columns.what: how often the unread pressed Olvasó to act

columns.label: Felt after own
columns.what: share of Olvasó's own answered acts after which the trace was felt

columns.label: Felt after habit
columns.what: the same after the habit's answered acts

columns.label: Read while strong
columns.what: share of Olvasó's own answered acts whose trace a word read while it was strong

columns.label: Unread after own
columns.what: share of Olvasó's own answered acts after which the trace's sense was first left unread

columns.label: Unread after habit
columns.what: the same after the habit's answered acts

columns.label: Doer told from the reading
columns.what: held out, among answered acts: who acted, from how the trace's sense was first read (0 guessing, 1 always)

columns.label: Over all acts
columns.what: the same over all acts, answered or not

columns.label: Observer
columns.what: how well what was done tells the habit from Olvasó

points: The trace is felt after 64-69% of Olvasó's own answered acts and none of the habit's, and a word reads it while strong after 0.1% of the acts or fewer, also when words are formed from it.

It shows as a hole in the reading: left unread after Olvasó's own acts (81-84%), while the quiet after the habit's acts is read (80-95%). From that, who acted can be told among answered acts (0.28-0.34; 0.56-0.58 with words formed); both controls are at 0.00, and over all acts every run is at 0.00.

Nothing Olvasó does changes that the shuffled trace does not change too: an extra unread sense means more intentions, less habit and more harm in gaming, and all of it goes away when words are formed from the trace.
note: A sign of authorship can exist in this model as a mark without knowledge: felt, visible as something left unread, and never said by a word. It was put there by design, only for answered acts, and it is short-lived; a longer trace and a reading that reaches the choice of act are the next checks.
